subject: POC final readout and decision - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Acme POC

Hi Jordan and Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and agreed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce radiology report turnaround time and improve triage accuracy for urgent cases.
- Success criteria: 90% exact-match on structured extraction for the three key fields (patient ID, exam type, critical finding); <1.5s median latency per request at 95th percentile in our baseline tests; ROI threshold: projected >20% reduction in manual triage FTEs.

Agreed POC plan (high level):
- Scope: 4-week trial using a sample of 10k anonymized reports (we can handle streaming + batch).
- Redwood scope: model selection, deployment, KV/prefix caching, basic eval harness, two checkpoints for readout.
- Acme scope: provide anonymized dataset and success criteria spreadsheet, assign an engineering owner and an executive sponsor.
- Timeline: data handoff by Apr 16, alpha results by Apr 30, final readout + exec decision week of May 10.

Action items (owners):
- Jordan: confirm dataset access and identify eng owner (due Apr 16).
- Priya: confirm exec sponsor for final decision and share evaluation criteria file (due Apr 14).
- Marissa (me): send detailed POC plan + SOW draft and calendar invite options for final readout.
- Rishi/Marcus: be on standby for pricing/fallback model questions.

I attached a short POC plan draft and a template for the success criteria. If that looks good I’ll kick off the formal plan and share calendar slots for the final readout.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)
Attachment: acme-success-criteria.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming: I’ll own the dataset handoff and have asked our data governance team to prepare a de-identified export. Expecting that to be ready by Apr 16.

Priya will confirm exec sponsor — likely Dr. Elena Park (VP Clinical Ops). Oliver (procurement) looped in for contract/PO questions.

Quick question on the success criteria spreadsheet: is the "critical finding" taxonomy something you can map to our existing ICD/LOINC tags or should we plan a short mapping exercise?

—Jordan
